title: TiMi: Empower Time Series Transformers with Multimodal Mixture of Experts
abstract: arXiv:2602.21693v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Multimodal time series forecasting has garnered significant attention for its potential to provide more accurate predictions than traditional single-modality models by leveraging rich information inherent in other modalities. However, due to fundamental challenges in modality alignment, existing methods often struggle to effectively incorporate multimodal data into predictions, particularly textual information that has a causal influence on time series fluctuations, such as emergency reports and policy announcements. In this paper, we reflect on the role of textual information in numerical forecasting and propose Time series transformers with Multimodal Mixture-of-Experts, TiMi, to unleash the causal reasoning capabilities of LLMs. Concretely, TiMi utilizes LLMs to generate inferences on future developments, which serve as guidance for time series forecasting. translated_title: TiMi：赋予时间序列Transformer多模态专家混合能力
translated_abstract: 多模态时间序列预测因其通过利用其他模态中蕴含的丰富信息，相比传统单模态模型能提供更准确的预测而受到广泛关注。然而，由于模态对齐方面的根本性挑战，现有方法往往难以有效地将多模态数据整合到预测中，尤其是那些对时间序列波动具有因果影响的文本信息，例如紧急报告和政策公告。在本文中，我们反思了文本信息在数值预测中的作用，并提出了一种带有时间序列Transformer和多模态专家混合的模型TiMi，以释放大型语言模型的因果推理能力。具体而言，TiMi利用大型语言模型生成对未来发展的推断，这些推断作为时间序列预测的指导。为了将外生因素和时间序列无缝整合到预测中，TiMi设计了一个多模态专家混合模块，该模块动态地选择并组合来自不同模态的信息，从而增强了模型对复杂动态的适应性和预测准确性。
tldr: TiMi通过多模态专家混合机制，利用大型语言模型生成因果推理指导，显著提升了时间序列预测的准确性和鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: TiMi leverages a multimodal mixture-of-experts mechanism, using LLM-generated causal inferences as guidance, to significantly enhance the accuracy and robustness of time series forecasting.
